Detox Red Cabbage Salad
By: Julia
Published: Friday, January 6, 2017 - 6:28am

Ingredients




¼ Red Cabbage (250g/8.8oz)
4-5 Mandarins
3 Medium Carrots
2 Medium Apples
2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Himalayan Salt to Taste
A Pinch of Black Pepper

Preparation

1 Wash the fruit & vegetables. Peel and grate carrots, peel, core and grate the apple. Grate or finely slice red cabbage. 2 Throw all the ingredients in a serving bowl including mandarin segments. 3 Pour over extra virgin olive oil and season with salt & black pepper. 4 Toss it around, taste for seasoning and when happy, serve! 5 This salad is perfect on its own or as a side dish especially with a heavy meal. It will also be great with barbeque in summer! 6 The post Yummylicious Detox Red Cabbage Salad appeared first on HappyFoods Tube.

About

Stay healthy with this vitamin packed Red Cabbage Salad! This salad is perfect for detox. It is light, crispy and yummy!
